reviewer: Isolated reviewer /root/ps3_pdf_review; fresh GBA contract and visual review

review_scope.method: Read content.json and devices/gba/references/SOURCES.md; individually opened all 12 PNG page renders with view_image; inspected the actual PDF with PyMuPDF for page count, dimensions and fonts drawing Chinese text. No GUI use, artwork edits, CAD edits or PDF regeneration. Read .local/gba-isolated/kami_delivery.log. On parent instruction, corrected only content.json brief.narrative metadata; final HTML/PDF unchanged.
review_scope.limitations: Visual/document consistency review, not independent native CAD reload, BRep regeneration, full component-ID audit or fresh verification of linked external source pages. Source coverage assessed against supplied SOURCES.md.

font.visual: No missing-glyph boxes or disruptive font substitutions observed.

visual.result: All 12 pages inspected. Titles, dimensions, captions, table rows and footer text are legible and within page boundaries. No blocking text/figure overlap or clipped views observed. Page 4 sections and page 5 dimensioned LCD remain clear.

preserve.result: AGB-001 Indigo and early AGB-CPU-02 are retained in headers/text. Reflective unlit TFT, 61.2 × 40.8 mm viewing area, 144.5 × 82 × 24.5 mm published envelope, 40-position LCD connection, two opposite AA cells, mono speaker and original ports are consistently stated/shown. Optional blank Game Pak is explicitly separate from original kit and visibly says NO GAME DATA.

counts.evidence: Pages 1, 11 and 12 distinguish entries from solids; pages 1 and 12 state 17 stages. The 14 page-11 group counts sum to 779.

approximation_boundaries.evidence: Local dimensions, curves, holes, components and internals are identified as study approximations throughout and on page 12; no manufacturing tolerance or functional circuit claim. Page 10 clearly distinguishes blank cartridge and removed CR1616.

source_coverage.evidence: Page 12 and footer references cover Nintendo specifications/manual, iFixit and Gekkio contributor evidence. SOURCES.md provides specific URLs, early board version, 40-contact basis, optional cartridge evidence and approximation boundaries; no contradiction with these supplied notes found.

native_dimension_reload.reason: Outside isolated PDF review scope; requires native CAD verification evidence.

kami_delivery.result: Independently read READY: 0 errors, 1 orphan warning, 0 data gaps. Content coverage, fonts, density and page contract OK. All page images inspected; flagged headings are not stranded.

findings.finding: Stale optical-drive narrative in brief metadata corrected on parent instruction to GBA-specific sequence. It never appeared in the rendered PDF. No artwork or PDF change.

The three silicone membranes occupy a small portion of the large left panel. Details remain readable and shoulder mechanism has a separate enlarged view, but tighter framing could improve use of the page.

metadata_correction.after: 总装与原版接口，分层爆炸与实体剖面，反射液晶、早期主板、输入机构与双 AA 供电，扬声器、另附空白卡带、组件索引和资料边界
